blurb: Lawrence Park Swim Club is a private swim club peacefully located at 293 Langford Rd. in Broomall PA. Lawrence Park Swim Club is currently accepting new memberships. Visit lpswimclub.org for more information. The Lawrence Park Swim team participates in the Delco League, which is made up of 18 teams in 3 divisions (A, B and C). This will be our thirteenth year in the "A" Division.
